integrity: The finite group is reconstructed from the six source permutations. Stabilizers, pointwise kernels, centrality, the commutator subgroup, and a splitting complement are recomputed exactly by the included verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies isotropy inside \(W(E_6)\), not projective automorphisms of a fixed cubic surface. Classical \(27\)-line literature is extensive, so a differently indexed older subgroup computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Weyl-monodromy isotropy of Shimada's cubic-surface Zariski pairs
